user.description: Paste the API token from the Get-Rucked app (Profile → Home Assistant → Generate New Token). Don't include "Bearer " — just the token itself.

reauth_confirm.description: Your Get-Rucked token for this account is no longer valid. Generate a new one in the app and paste it here.

error.premium_required: This account doesn't have an active Get-Rucked Premium subscription.
error.rate_limited: Rate limited by the Get-Rucked API — wait a minute and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Get-Rucked API. Check your connection and try again.
error.account_mismatch: This token belongs to a different Get-Rucked account than the one being re-authenticated.

abort.already_configured: This Get-Rucked account is already configured.

premium_required.title: Get-Rucked Premium required
premium_required.description: Your Get-Rucked account's Premium subscription has lapsed, so stats can't be fetched right now. This will clear itself once Premium is active again — no need to do anything here.
